transcript: Dogs descended from wolves some 15,000 years ago Through living with humans, they acquired roles As hunters, guards and companions In modern times, dogs play various roles Guide dogs, police dogs, therapy dogs They are intelligent, sensitive And perceive human emotions With surprising accuracy Scientists have demonstrated That dogs read human facial expressions And show distinct emotional responses When an owner is sad, the dog seems sad When an owner is happy, the dog wags its tail Pet therapy, which eases the loneliness of the elderly has also been gaining attention in recent years For an elderly person living alone, a dog becomes a member of the family and a daily source of meaning But keeping a dog also comes with responsibility Food, medical costs, time for walks One must be prepared for a commitment of 15 years or more Sadly there are owners who make excuses and abandon their animals Not a few dogs are sent to shelters and may never find new homes To take an animal as family is to carry responsibility to the end Those who cannot must never treat them as disposable The bond between dogs and humans is a special one Nurtured over thousands of years We should protect this bond by caring for animals responsibly

segments.text: Dogs descended from wolves some 15,000 years ago
Through living with humans, they acquired roles
As hunters, guards and companions
In modern times, dogs play various roles
Guide dogs, police dogs, therapy dogs
They are intelligent, sensitive
And perceive human emotions
With surprising accuracy
Scientists have demonstrated
That dogs read human facial expressions
And show distinct emotional responses
When an owner is sad, the dog seems sad
When an owner is happy, the dog wags its tail
Pet therapy, which eases the loneliness of the elderly
has also been gaining attention in recent years
For an elderly person living alone, a dog becomes a member of the family
and a daily source of meaning
But keeping a dog also comes with responsibility
Food, medical costs, time for walks
One must be prepared for a commitment of 15 years or more
Sadly there are owners who make excuses and abandon their animals
Not a few dogs are sent to shelters and may never find new homes
To take an animal as family is to carry responsibility to the end
Those who cannot must never treat them as disposable
The bond between dogs and humans is a special one
Nurtured over thousands of years
We should protect this bond by caring for animals responsibly
